_comment: Capacity-aware provisioner state (D3). Tracks known Nitro-capable EC2 instances and which physical cores their enclaves have claimed. Update via provisioner.sh, not by hand.
_capacity_model: Nitro Enclaves reserve whole physical cores (both hyperthread siblings together) -- never a fraction of one, and CPU0's core always stays with the parent OS. free_cores = physical_cores - cores_reserved_for_parent - sum(enclave.cores for enclave in enclaves). An instance can accept a new enclave only if free_cores >= the enclave's requested cores (minimum 1).
